mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic demand, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate remains below 4%, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth is positive and unemployment is low, it indicates strong economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive and unemployment is low, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate is high, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing non-farm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Non-farm payroll employment increases, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: CPI is high, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production increases and unemployment decreases, it signals strong economic supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Industrial production is up and unemployment is down, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, increased housing starts indicate sustained demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Housing starts are high, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.
